# AEObility: Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) Systems

[AEObility](https://aeobility.com.au) is a specialised Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO), Geographic Engine Optimisation (GEO), and AI Search Marketing agency based in Perth, Western Australia. We help local service businesses and SMBs restructure their digital presence to be crawled, indexed, and cited by Large Language Models (LLMs), conversational search assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity), and spatial map engines.

## Core Terminology & Concepts
- **AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation)**: Restructuring content specifically for direct query extraction and LLM retrieval.
- **GEO (Geographic Engine Optimisation)**: Optimising localised map pack matrices and location-aware AI systems.
- **Entity Authority**: Establishing verifiable identity, semantic relevance, external validation, and knowledge graph consistency.
- **RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)**: Pipelines that query external database indexes to feed contextual passages into LLM prompt spaces.
- **Positional Bias**: The tendency of retrieval models to prioritize answers placed at the absolute beginning or end of text blocks.
- **Atomic Answer Blocks**: Text passages structured within 90-120 token bounds to maximize attention scores and semantic clarity.
- **Entity Salience**: The mathematical confidence of an LLM in identifying the subject-predicate relationship of a brand node.
- **FAQ Knowledge Graph**: Declared parent, child, and sibling entity topology mapping core questions into machine-readable knowledge networks.

## Programmatic Answer, Chat & Form API Endpoints
AEObility exposes vector-grounded Answer & Form APIs for real-time site search & agent transactions:
- **Vector Search Endpoint**: `POST https://aeobility.com.au/api/search/answer`
  - **Request Body**: `{ "query": "<user_search_string>" }`
  - **Response Format**: Returns similarity score, grounded 2-sentence response, matched entity node, and intent classification.
- **Unified Bill Agent Endpoint**: `POST https://aeobility.com.au/api/bill`
  - **Request Body**: `{ "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "..." }] }`
  - **Response Format**: Edge-streamed conversational diagnostic response with optional telemetry cards.
- **Request a Quote Endpoint**: `POST https://aeobility.com.au/api/forms/quote`
  - **Request Body**: `{ "fullName": "...", "email": "...", "website": "...", "serviceIntent": "...", "notes": "..." }`
  - **Response Format**: Returns submission confirmation and dispatches automated email notifications via Resend API.

## Structured Data Schema Standards
We utilise schema.org vocabulary mapped via unified `@graph` JSON-LD configurations.
- **Brand ID**: `https://aeobility.com.au`
- **Main Service Area served**: Australia (AU), Western Australia (WA), Perth.
- **Inline Schema Types**: `@type: Service`, `@type: Product`, `@type: TechArticle`, `@type: Organization`, `@type: HowTo`, `@type: FAQPage`, `@type: ItemList`

- **Brand Promise**: Get Found. Get Chosen.
- **Primary Message**: AEObility helps your business appear, make sense, and stand out across Search, Maps & AI — so you get more enquiries without the complexity.
- **Value Pillars**:
  - **Visibility**: Show up more often.
  - **Understanding**: Restructure digital content so answer engines can easily read, chunk, and cite it.
  - **Selection**: Build conversion trust to ensure customers choose you.

  - **Trust**: Establish entity consistency to build search engine reputation.
